title: Trump hails jobs surge, says Iran talks ‘going well’
content: Trump hails jobs surge, says Iran talks ‘going well’ Trump hails jobs surge, says Iran talks ‘going well’ US President Donald Trump hailed stronger-than-expected jobs growth before pivoting to Iran, saying negotiations with Tehran “seem to be going quite well”. Trump offered no further details on the talks as he arrived in Wisconsin for an agriculture event. Published On 5 Jun 2026
